definitions.broken: A defect was reproduced in isolated browser checks.
definitions.missing: No implementing view/state/function found in the supplied source.

defects: Search loses focus
Typing biryani leaves query b; typing chicken in Pantry leaves c.
ordinary_search_typing
Keep the same input while updating results, or restore focus to the new input.
Pasted quantity ignores its unit
Chicken - 500 g saves quantity 500 in the ingredient’s kg unit. Negative -2 is parsed as positive 2.
paste_ignores_units_and_overwrites_stock
Parse and validate quantity and unit together. Reject invalid input and review the converted amount.
Undo leaves the cooked meal counted
Chicken stock goes 1000 → 999.3333 → 1000, while cooking history still contains one meal and Stats still counts it.
cooking_deduction_and_undo_log
Tie stock movements and history to the same event and reverse both.
Purchase undo temporarily contradicts the checkbox
Undo returns Onion stock to 0 while the row remains checked and says in pantry. The purchase marker has a 2.6-second removal timer.
threshold_shopping_uses_assumed_purchase
Reverse the purchase status with its stock update, without relying on a later timer.
A local October meal is grouped into September
At 01:30 Karachi time on 1 October, the log displays 01 Oct but stores iso 2026-09-30 and Stats groups it under Sep 2026.
local_date_month_boundary
Store the household local date separately from the timestamp used for ordering.
Failed saving is hidden
With a simulated storage quota exception, Chicken changes 1 → 1.25 in memory, then reload returns 1 without an error message.
HTML 121
storage_failure_is_silent
Expose failed saves and retain a recoverable pending change. This is a simulated failure, not evidence of past user data loss.
workflow: Choose the usual number of people, meal names, preferred units, storage locations, and solo or shared access. Review starter stock instead of accepting sample quantities as real inventory.
Keep the existing 22 entries, ingredient quantities, times, notes, videos, and written links. Add and edit family recipes with full steps. Photo recipe import gets its own reviewed flow.
Add items manually or review items detected from a picture. Enter quantity and unit, storage location, and optional expiry/frozen-on date. Keep uncertain amounts visible.
Today shows ready recipes and the best near matches. Noor can cook spontaneously or assign recipes and servings to dates and meal slots.
Combine the selected meals, subtract available stock once, and add chosen minimum-stock top-ups. Group by aisle and show dish-specific shortages and editable store hints.
Tick what was bought, confirm the actual quantity and optional price, and update stock once. Link a receipt and grocery photo if they describe the same purchase.
Open the scaled recipe, instructions, notes, or video. Record the actual cooking date, meal type, servings, and ingredient amounts used. Then update stock and history together.
Handle the rest of kitchen life
Record chai ingredients and other everyday usage, remaining portions, food moved to the freezer, finished items, and waste. Corrections can be undone without corrupting history.
See monthly meal and dish summaries, servings prepared, stock movements, and grocery spending where prices were captured. Share only on user action and support validated export and restore.

limitations: No native Excel recalculation was performed. Formula text, cached values, raw XML dropdowns, hidden content, and relationships were inspected.
Browser checks used disposable isolated data and local files. No real household data or original source file was changed.
Physical Android/iPhone camera capture, home-screen installation, offline synchronization, cloud vision, multi-user access, and external sharing delivery were not tested.
Recipe/video URLs and store suggestions were preserved but their current availability, accuracy, ranking, prices, and delivery claims were not verified.
A valid backup/restore was tested; malformed restore payloads were not tested.
